unit_cn: Unit 2 Art and Artists 艺术与艺术家
source: 上外版必修三 Unit 2 词表(真词,跳过△超纲词与专有名词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、围绕艺术家/绘画/音乐主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The painting reveals the artist's hope for a harmonious life.
words.example_cn: 这幅画表达了画家对和谐生活的期望。

words.example_en: Qi Baishi often placed a tiny figure in the corner of his painting.
words.example_cn: 齐白石常在画作角落画一个小小的人物。

words.example_en: His works are rich in expression and feeling.
words.example_cn: 他的作品富于表现力和情感。

words.example_en: The artist liked to focus on the finer details of each flower.
words.example_cn: 这位艺术家喜欢专注于每朵花的细微之处。

words.meaning_cn: 充满活力的;精力充沛的
words.example_en: He painted with bright colours and energetic strokes.
words.example_cn: 他用明亮的色彩和充满活力的笔触作画。

words.example_en: A single bold stroke can bring a fish to life on paper.
words.example_cn: 寥寥一笔就能让纸上的鱼栩栩如生。

words.example_en: He created his works in a fresh and lively manner.
words.example_cn: 他以清新而生动的方式创作作品。

words.example_en: His art reflected an international trend in modern painting.
words.example_cn: 他的艺术反映了现代绘画的国际潮流。

words.example_en: He expressed modern ideas in a typical Chinese way.
words.example_cn: 他以典型的中国方式表达现代理念。

words.example_en: The world recognises Qi Baishi first as a great painter.
words.example_cn: 世人首先把齐白石视为一位伟大的画家。

words.example_en: As he grew older, the artist said what he pursued was world peace.
words.example_cn: 随着年纪增长,这位艺术家说他所追求的是世界和平。

words.example_en: He was awarded the International Peace Prize in 1956.
words.example_cn: 他于1956年被授予国际和平奖。

words.example_en: The prize was given to him by a famous peace council.
words.example_cn: 这个奖项是由一个著名的和平理事会颁给他的。

words.example_en: The singer extended his warm greetings to all the guests.
words.example_cn: 这位歌手向所有来宾致以热情的问候。

words.example_en: He sent his warmest greetings to the members of the academy.
words.example_cn: 他向学院的成员致以最热烈的问候。

words.example_en: Many distinguished guests came to honour the great artist.
words.example_cn: 许多杰出的来宾前来向这位伟大的艺术家致敬。

words.example_en: Bob Dylan won the Nobel Prize for Literature in 2016.
words.example_cn: 鲍勃·迪伦于2016年获得诺贝尔文学奖。

words.example_en: Shakespeare is one of the greatest literary figures in history.
words.example_cn: 莎士比亚是历史上最伟大的文学人物之一。

words.example_en: Their works are often spoken of in respectful tones.
words.example_cn: 人们常以充满敬意的语气谈论他们的作品。

words.example_en: He said he never had the slightest chance of winning such a prize.
words.example_cn: 他说自己丝毫没有赢得这样一个奖项的机会。

words.example_en: The director wondered how the new play should be staged.
words.example_cn: 导演在思考这部新剧该如何上演。

words.example_en: Even great artists must deal with many ordinary matters.
words.example_cn: 即使是伟大的艺术家也必须处理许多平常的事务。

words.example_en: I bet the question "Is this art?" never crossed his mind.
words.example_cn: 我敢说"这是艺术吗?"这个问题从未在他脑中出现过。

words.example_en: Playing concerts meant he was reaching a big audience.
words.example_cn: 举办音乐会意味着他正在触及大量的听众。

words.example_en: He has made dozens of records over his long career.
words.example_cn: 在漫长的职业生涯中,他录制了几十张唱片。

words.example_en: The artist said he was deeply grateful for the great honour.
words.example_cn: 这位艺术家说他对这一巨大荣誉深表感激。

words.example_en: Like Shakespeare, he is often occupied with both his songs and daily matters.
words.example_cn: 和莎士比亚一样,他常常忙于创作歌曲和处理日常事务。

words.example_en: He asked himself whether he was recording in the right studio.
words.example_cn: 他问自己是否在合适的录音室里录音。

words.example_en: He thanked the academy for ultimately giving such a wonderful answer.
words.example_cn: 他感谢学院最终给出了如此美妙的答案。

words.example_en: The artist who was in charge of the show chose the best paintings.
words.example_cn: 负责这场展览的艺术家挑选了最好的画作。

words.example_en: The painting reveals the artist's love of nature and life.
words.example_cn: 这幅画揭示了艺术家对自然和生命的热爱。

words.meaning_cn: 生动的;活泼的;充满生气的
words.example_en: His paintings of shrimps look fresh and lively.
words.example_cn: 他画的虾看起来清新而生动。

words.example_en: Doves were a common subject in his later paintings.
words.example_cn: 鸽子是他后期画作中常见的题材。

words.example_en: Using heavy ink, he created strong and simple shapes.
words.example_cn: 他用浓墨创造出有力而简洁的形象。

words.example_en: He left some parts of the paper blank, planning to add flowers later.
words.example_cn: 他把纸上一些地方留白,打算以后再添上花朵。

words.example_en: While many artists retire from public life when old, he took on more duties.
words.example_cn: 许多艺术家年老时退出公共生活,他却承担了更多责任。

words.example_en: He actively took on more social responsibilities in his old age.
words.example_cn: 晚年时他积极承担起更多的社会责任。

words.example_en: A painter must decide what message to convey through colour and shape.
words.example_cn: 画家必须决定通过色彩和形状传达什么信息。

words.example_en: It takes some knowledge to appreciate a work of art.
words.example_cn: 欣赏一件艺术品需要一定的知识。

words.example_en: Winning the prize was something he could never have imagined.
words.example_cn: 获得这个奖项是他从未能想象到的事。

words.example_en: For Van Gogh, night was often a time of creativity.
words.example_cn: 对梵高来说,夜晚常常是创作的时刻。

words.example_en: His paintings became a great source of inspiration for songs and films.
words.example_cn: 他的画作成为歌曲和电影的巨大灵感来源。

words.example_en: Loving Vincent is the world's first fully oil-painted feature film.
words.example_cn: 《至爱梵高》是世界上第一部完全用油画绘成的故事片。

words.example_en: The young musician was nervous before performing on stage.
words.example_cn: 这位年轻音乐家在上台表演前很紧张。
